text: Function Extraction 是一个 DSH 技能插件，可在支持 Agent Skills 的编程代理中使用。它将 SKILL.md 注册为运行时技能，引导代理先确认目标功能和入口，再从入口追踪调用链、业务逻辑、数据流、状态变化及异常分支，并按模板编写技术开发文档。它还能指导代理生成流程图、时序图和模块依赖图，适合需要理解或复现现有代码功能的开发者。插件本身不要求额外账号、密钥或外部服务。

Function Extraction is a DSH coding skill that registers SKILL.md at runtime. It guides agents to confirm a feature and entry point, trace logic and data flow, then document implementation with Mermaid diagrams. It helps developers understand code and needs no extra account, key, or service.
帮我梳理某个功能从入口到结束的完整代码调用链。
想根据现有项目代码写一份功能技术文档。
让代理解释一个功能的数据流和业务逻辑。
我想为代码里的功能补上异常分支说明和流程图。
没有入口线索时，帮我先搜索并确认功能从哪里开始。
需要把页面、路由或方法触发后的实现步骤交接给其他开发者。
Help me trace a feature from its entry point through the full call flow.
Generate a technical document explaining the business logic and data flow in my codebase.
Function Extraction 的功能「追踪功能实现链路」：从用户提供或确认的入口出发，沿调用链分析至流程结束，并关注影响逻辑或状态的关键代码。使用者先给出功能名称和入口线索；代理据此生成链路说明。
Function Extraction 的功能「编写实现技术文档」：代理按内置模板整理功能描述、触发条件、业务步骤、数据流程、异常处理、依赖及配置等章节，产出便于开发者理解和实现的文档。
Function Extraction 的功能「生成流程图与时序图」：在分析功能逻辑和调用流程后，指导代理输出 Mermaid 流程图与时序图；模块依赖关系也可用图表呈现。图表内容依据具体功能选择。

dsh-skill-function-extraction README · Function Extraction：[](https://skills.sh/addxing/function-extraction)

A skill for extracting a complete feature implementation chain from a codebase and generating a technical development document with business logic, data flow, exception handling, and Mermaid diagrams. Works with AI coding tools that support Agent Skills.

dsh-skill-function-extraction README · Install：```bash
npx skills add addxing/function-extraction
```

dsh-skill-function-extraction README · DeepSeek Harness：This repo follows the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Skill format. Clone it into a skills directory and it will be auto-discovered:

```bash
dsh-skill-function-extraction README · User-level install (available in all projects)：git clone https://github.com/addxing/function-extraction ~/.dsh/skills/function-extraction

dsh-skill-function-extraction README · Project-level install (current project only)：git clone https://github.com/addxing/function-extraction .dsh/skills/function-extraction
```

DSH hot-reloads the skills directory after cloning; the skill becomes available in new sessions.

Or install it as an official bundle plugin in one line (requires pnpm; restart the web app afterwards):bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:addxing/function-extraction#main"
```

dsh-skill-function-extraction README · Usage：Select this skill using your tool’s skill mechanism, or ask for it by name. Invocation syntax and automatic activation depend on the tool.

After installing the skill, ask your AI agent to use it when you need a feature-level implementation document:

```text
Use the function-extraction skill to document the login flow implementation.
```

For best results, provide:

dsh-skill-function-extraction README · Usage：- the feature name
- the entry file, class, method, route, page, button text, or other clues
- the expected output language or documentation scope, if different from the default

If the entry point is missing, the skill guides the agent to search the codebase and ask you to confirm the correct entry before continuing.

dsh-skill-function-extraction README · What It Does：This skill guides an agent to:

- confirm the target feature and entry point
- trace the implementation from entry to completion
- identify key business logic, data flow, state changes, and exception handling
- generate a technical development document using `template.md`
- include Mermaid flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and dependency graphs when useful

dsh-skill-function-extraction README · Files：- `SKILL.md` - the skill instructions
- `template.md` - the output document template
